name: animlib-chunk1220
note: DeluxePaint large-page lookup and frame decoder from animlib.cpp (1-290).
auditSeams: LittleShort and LittleLong are identity on this little-endian host, and the load writes those values back into the caller buffer. DrawFrame paints from the stored frame through the frame before the request, then stores the request. A short opcode of 0x80 falls through to the long opcode. Skipped pixels keep the previous frame. An odd preamble length skips one extra byte.
auditRationale: UNCredited animlib.cpp 1-290 (+290). The file ends at 290. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/common/thirdparty/animlib.cpp --start 1 --end 290 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.
